kontext: She wears them around the clock, in the shower and asleep. Classic studs used to go missing on her, or catch on her scarf in winter.
rolle: Sales professional and style consultant, Beams
text: Indispensable in my life 365 days a year.

kontext: With normal studs she kept reaching up to check that both were still there. That has gone.
text: Wore them through a 100-mile race and forgot along the way that she had them on at all.

kontext: When nothing goes to plan, doing her hair, putting on lipstick and clicking in her earrings changes the mood completely.
text: She does not take them off any more. They stay in right up to the bathtub.
